bugs_found: compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without validation
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), accepting invalid schedules and under/overcharging
transfer does not coerce/validate amount as Decimal, finite, or currency-scale-compatible; mixed numeric types or NaN/Infinity can crash or corrupt balances
transfer is not atomic: debit is applied before credit, so a failing/custom balance setter on account_to can leave money removed without receipt consistency
apply_fee only warns on negative amount and still returns a more-negative result after applying minimum fee; negative monetary inputs should be rejected
fx_convert does not validate rate positivity or finiteness, allowing zero/negative/NaN/Infinity exchange rates to produce invalid converted amounts
all money functions omit quantization/rounding policy to currency minor units, causing silent fractional-cent balances and receipts
